source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Inspect the following, and make sure they were each properly
inspected by the water-quality inspector:
a. Filter and backwash valves
b. Sand level
c. Air relief
d. Gauges
e. Any other equipment found at the facility


Then inspect and make sure that the following were checked and tested:
a. Inlet pressure
b. Outlet pressure (via the relief to the waste stream)
c. Back washing
d. Flow rate when checked
e. Flow rate when sand changes
f. Chlorine limits
g. Bacteriological test results
h. Any other equipment or devices not listed

3. Check all administrative and technical paperwork, such as:
a. Daily entry water and waste water logs
b. Check all inspection records to make sure inspections occurred when reported and at the specified intervals and that they were performed by qualified inspectors
c. Check all records of all corrective repairs or maintenance and
